units: <cite ref="Pesachim 119a">Pes. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>מלך בו״ד מנצחין אותו וע׳ וכ׳</he> a human King grieves when he is defeated, but the Lord &c.; (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite> <he>כועס</he>), v. <cite ref="N01108"><he>נָצַח</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 5a:8">Ber. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>מוכר ע׳ ולוקח שמח</he> the seller grieves (because he has to part with a dear possession), and the buyer is glad; a. e.—Pl. <he>עֲצֵבִים</he>, <he>עֲצֵבִין</he>; <cite ref="P01099"><he>עֲצֵבוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="P01114"><he>עֲצֵי׳</he></cite>.
Ib. 67ᵃ; a. e.—Trnsf. (of the fingers of the hand) pressed together, narrow, opp. שׂוֹחֵק.
